title: Engineering docs describe controls that no longer match the code
expected: Docs match implementation (CONTRIBUTING.md: docs must not drift).
actual: TD-004 says the backend is JavaScript (it is TypeScript, typechecked in CI). TD-003 says no browser E2E exists (11 Playwright specs in frontend-next/e2e). ADR-004 and an auth.ts comment say the JWT is kept in localStorage (memory only per api/client.ts). MESSAGING_AUDIT lists reactions as missing (backend/db/migrate70.js, routes/messages.ts:998). Scorecard cites 255 endpoints; live routers expose 354.
impact: New contributors and reviewers act on wrong assumptions (e.g. re-doing completed work or misjudging XSS exposure).
fix: Mark TD-003/TD-004 done or re-scope; amend ADR-004 status to Superseded by TD-001/TD-014; fix the auth.ts comment; add a dated 'superseded' note to MESSAGING_AUDIT; regenerate scorecard figures from scripts.
